name: Workboat USV (example)
notes: Example only. 6 m x 2.2 m uncrewed workboat, twin stern thrusters (differential thrust steers). Inertia: solid box. Added inertia: sway and heave added mass about the centre, A*a^2/3; roll about 20% of the rigid-body value. Floats at about 37% of hull depth. Drag from 0.5*rho*Cd*A on the wetted section. Lateral plane: a fixed 1.2 m2 fin 1.8 m aft stands for the keel, skeg and aft hull area that keep the boat directionally stable against its Munk moment (very low aspect ratio, lift slope 0.8/rad with the hull as an end plate). Twin spade rudders behind the thrusters, 0.06 m2 each, 35 deg. Trials: tactical diameter about 4.6 L at 19 kn with full rudder, 10/10 zig-zag overshoots about 2 deg.
